text:
maria: Quick sync — landing ops for the launch post + webinar next Tue. Need a tidy handoff: keyword list, schema snippet (FAQ + Event), internal anchor chain, and a redirect plan for old CTAs. Who can own the audit?

jake: I can run the KW audit today. drop the draft seed list and I'll QA for intent buckets + SERP comps.

sam: I'll own messaging iterations (subject lines + meta descriptions) and the benchmark narrative paragraph for the post. Want a short AB test on the H2s.

ashley: I can do redirects and canonical checks. Do we need to redirect the old /resources/* to the new landing or keep some as canonicalized archives? Also can set up the registration UTM routing to our lead inbox.

maria: prefer redirect to new landing for primary CTAs, archive older pages with 301 -> /launch and keep a small archive index. Ashley, can you paste a small redirect map when you have a sec?

ashley: draft redirect map (will expand):
```
/old-webinar-signup -> /launch?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=webinar
/resources/benchmark-2023 -> /benchmarks/2024-benchmark (301)
/blog/intro-to-x -> /blog/updated-intro-to-x (302 until verif)
```

jake: For internal linking, suggest an "anchorchain": primary CTA in hero -> 3 contextual CTAs in mid-content -> related resources block. I'll annotate anchors in the KW doc with suggested anchor text (short, intent-focused).

sam: For benchmark narrative, I'm drafting two versions: one that emphasizes latency/cost wins (tech audience) and one that focuses on developer UX (product audience). We'll map variants to the same landing but with different hero copy.

maria: nice — also need JSON-LD snippets for Event and FAQ. seo-bot, can you run schema validator after Jake's changes?

seo-bot: Heads up — will validate schema once pushed to staging. Will report errors as a thread comment.

ashley: assigned redirect task in GH: #2345. I'll run smoke deploy to staging after redirects are in. Expect downtime risk: none (301s).

jake: uploaded KW audit (link: https://docs/redwood/kw-audit-launch-3369123456). Quick notes: 12 high-priority KW, 8 mid, 6 long-tail. I'll add anchor suggestions inline.

sam: putting two hero copy options in the doc. Quick poll: prefer tone A (straight technical) or B (product-forward)? :thinking_face:

maria: product-forward for homepage placement, technical on developer blog. Great progress — can we reconvene tomorrow 11am to finalize schema + redirects? :thumbsup:

ashley: works for me. I'll queue the redirect PR and post the staging URL here when ready.

jake: done for KW audit comments. tagging @maria for final anchor approvals.

seo-bot: schema validation passed on sample FAQ snippet (no errors). Will run full pass after PR. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks team — putting action items in the launch checklist.
